title: Cory Johnson:
title_short: Cory Johnson · AYH · That's Good Medicine
headline: A NIWRC staff member says being in Native community is what fuels him, because there are few Native people where he lives, and that is good medicine. His message: support Native people, their art, their projects and their businesses.
story: Cory lives in St. Louis, where there are not many Native people. Travel to conferences and time in community gives him energy. “That's good medicine” is the line of this cut.
It ends on his message to support Native people, their artwork, projects and businesses. The line “and vote for Native people” is held back until Nick or NIWRC says OK.

Loops: L1 “Are you happy?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:16 (“good medicine”, “passionate”). L2 “What is his one message?” opens at 0:18 and closes on “support their businesses”. Stakes: Native people who live far from community.
do: Open on Cory with the hook text <q>Are you happy?</q> already on screen at 0:00.
Keep “that's good medicine” as the high point of the middle. Put the key line on screen.
Cut “It makes me doing the work that I do.” It is a stumble. “That makes me energized. Passionate.” is enough.
End the message on “support their businesses”.
Name super at 00:04, lower left, 2 s. Match Qendrim's approved NIWRC look.
dont: Do not use “and vote for Native people” unless Nick or NIWRC says OK. The shoot brief kept staff away from politics.
Do not use “Yeah, just being in community.” It repeats his answer.
Do not use the countdown or any crew line at the start or end.
No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
